title_en: Flavio Bolsonaro lands in US, declares himself 'leader' of Brazil
summary_en: Flavio Bolsonaro declared himself the rightful leader of his country despite losing the presidential election runoff on Sunday. He and his family have fled to the US.

title_en: Flavio Bolsonaro claims he is Brazil's true leader after fleeing to US
summary_en: Brazil's defeated right-wing presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro insisted Wednesday he is his country's rightful leader after arriving in the United States to start a self-imposed exile.
